messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert: multi-region failover stalled during traffic-shift. Impact: increased 5xx and timeouts for EU customers. Affected regions: us-west-2 -> eu-west-1. Paging @oncall-sre :rotating_light:
Maya Singh: I'm oncall, joining the bridge now. saw traffic-shift job start @2754321800 and progress to step 2/4 then stop accepting new sessions in eu-west.
Ravi Kapoor: infra graphs show spikes in TCP retries and backend connection resets coincident with shift start. 5xx rate jumped from 0.6% -> 9% for eu-frontends.
Lin Zhao: just checked deploy history 10m window: no service deploys. DNS changes: none in platform. Provider notes: we have a reported POP instability affecting transatlantic peering.
networking-bot: Cloud provider ticket #NET-2026 opened. Initial triage: BGP flaps observed on a small subset of POPs on transatlantic links. ETA for vectoring: 20m.
ops-bot: Traffic-shift job details: policy=gradual, batch=2000rps per step, current progress=step 2/4, paused by system after repeated healthcheck failures.
oncall-sre: Can we temporarily increase healthcheck thresholds and resume? What are the risks?
Maya Singh: risks: masking real backend failures. But short-term increase from 5s -> 25s could reduce false-positives from transient network blips. Recommend pause resume + local mitigations first.
Ravi Kapoor: attempting local mitigations: 1) drain 15% of eu backend pool 2) restart edge lb workers with backoff 3) bump healthcheck timeout to 20s. Applying now.
Lin Zhao: running dig+cache-checks. Observed some edge caches still returning old us-west addresses for eu frontends due to inconsistent EDNS behavior. sample: `;; OPT PSEUDOSECTION: ...`
support-bot: first customer reports arrived at 2754321822. 300 error-related tickets in last 7m. Top impacted: data-dashboard, metrics-proxy.
Maya Singh: I've contacted provider engineer via ticket and asked for BGP adjacency checks on transatlantic peers.
networking-bot: Provider response: "We confirm intermittent route withdrawal on several links. Our NOC is performing targeted flaps suppression and will advise in 15m."
Ravi Kapoor: after restarts, some eu nodes recovered. healthcheck success up from 48% -> 70% on restarted hosts. 5xx rate down to 4.5%. Good but still elevated.
Lin Zhao: we should consider partial failover only for critical endpoints (auth, billing, ingestion) to us-east-1. Full failover will cause cache misses and higher latencies.
Maya Singh: agree. Product decision needed: failover critical routes now?
Customer Success: recommend failover for auth and ingestion to limit customer-visible errors for key flows. Accept latency tradeoff.
ops-bot: prepared command: `rdns route --services auth,ingest --from eu-west --to us-east --ttl 30 --mode immediate`
oncall-sre: please run canary first: route 10% of auth traffic to us-east then monitor 5m. If stable, increase to 100% for critical services.
Ravi Kapoor: initiating 10% canary now.
networking-bot: provider note: after our mitigation steps some POPs show improved BGP stability. Monitoring continues.
Maya Singh: canaries are green for auth (latency +40ms) and ingest (latency +80ms) with error rate <0.2%. Proceed to cut 100% for these services?
Customer Success: proceed. Notify customers and update status page.
support-bot: sending templated notices to top-20 customers and updating SLA tracking.
Ravi Kapoor: executing full reroute for auth/ingest to us-east. TTL=30. propagation expected within 2-3 minutes for most resolvers.
Lin Zhao: synthetic checks show global success improving; overall 5xx for EU back to ~1.2% and latency returned to near baseline for routed traffic. Some edge caches still hitting affected POPs — expected to clear as TTLs expire.
oncall-sre: handoff plan: @Lin Zhao will monitor the mitigated services for 90m, @Maya Singh remains on-call for escalation. I'll be available if BGP flaps reoccur.
Maya Singh: open action items before handoff: 1) keep provider ticket open and escalate if flaps resume 2) continue rolling restarts for remaining unhealthy eu nodes 3) update postmortem draft with timeline and mitigations 4) customer comms follow-up.
Ravi Kapoor: rolling restarts finishing; eu pool healthy count 92%. 5xx down to 0.8%.
networking-bot: provider update: "Routing stabilized across affected transatlantic links. NOC will monitor for 2 hours."
Customer Success: status page: mitigated 1 - partial degradation resolved; critical services rerouted. Will add note about higher latency for rerouted flows.
Lin Zhao: taking monitoring handoff now at 2754322151. will escalate to oncall if we see error rate bump >1% sustained for 5m.
Maya Singh: thanks team. closing the paging loop; will schedule incident blameless postmortem and include ASN-level routing changes and runbook adjustments. :white_check_mark:
